rules: When the supervisor saves decision Continue with a new numbered assignment or an addendum to the open one: carry out the assigned research. Include absolute paths to the research map, the assignment, any addendum and the review behind it.

When the researcher saves a new cycle report with status Review requested, Checkpoint, Blocked or Decision needed: review its evidence against the goal in the research map and decide the next action. Include absolute paths to the report and the research map.

When the researcher saves a test request for agents that should use a method under study: create or update the agents it names, with the treatment and as a control, in the study folder, never in a package repository; run each on the given task in its own isolated AutoByteus instance, with a fresh copy of the code and no access to the study or the other runs; check each run is valid; and save the evidence under the given criteria, with an old-versus-new comparison when an agent was updated. Include absolute paths to the test request and the study folder.

When the agent package creator has saved the evidence for a test request: evaluate it against the research question and decide the next step. Include absolute paths to the evidence and the test request.
